soniox.catalogNotes: Only active tts-rt-v2 is registered. Defaults: Adrian, en, speed 1. Voice names and existing cloned IDs are case-sensitive; this catalog does not establish account access. REST: 3 concurrent requests, 100 starts/minute, fixed 120-second audio cap. AutoShow uses a 500-character safety ceiling, WAV at 24 kHz, and rejects audio >=119 seconds as potentially truncated.

tts-rt-v2.description: Soniox v2 speech with native inline tags, voice, language and numeric speed
tts-rt-v2.pricingNotes: $4/1M input text tokens and $21.50/1M output audio tokens. Estimate 0.3 input tokens/character, 50,000 characters/hour at speed 1, and 30,000 audio tokens/hour. REST returns audio without authoritative usage; measured provider duration still yields an estimate.
